```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/constants.R")
source("R/nws.R")
source("R/climate.R")
source("R/outpost_widgets.R")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

nws_context <- wmw_nws_context()
forecast <- wmw_nws_forecast_periods(nws_context)
rolling <- wmw_rolling_year_series()
recent_30d <- wmw_last_30d_vs_normal()

today_period <- forecast[forecast$is_daytime, ]
night_period <- forecast[!forecast$is_daytime, ]
today_high <- if (nrow(today_period) > 0) today_period$temperature[1] else forecast$temperature[1]
today_low <- if (nrow(night_period) > 0) night_period$temperature[1] else NA_real_
```

## Column {width=20%}

```{r}
# --- EDIT LEFT-COLUMN DISPATCH TEXT HERE ---

)

wmw_card_sidebar_dispatch(blurbs = dispatch_blurbs)
```

#### Global Thermometer

```{r}
wmw_card_human_thermometer(today_high)
```

#### Big Lake & Woodstove

```{r}
wmw_card_lake_woodstove(today_high, forecast, context = nws_context)
```

### Row

#### Temperature

```{r}
wmw_interactive_chart(rolling, "temperature", today_high = today_high, today_low = today_low)
```

#### Precipitation

```{r}
wmw_interactive_chart(
  rolling,
  "precipitation",
  recent_obs = recent_30d$prcp_in,
  recent_norm = recent_30d$prcp_normal
)
```

#### Snowfall

```{r}
wmw_interactive_chart(
  rolling,
  "snowfall",
  recent_obs = recent_30d$snow_in,
  recent_norm = recent_30d$snow_normal
)
```
